title: Low Profile Engine Bay Cowl Filter Set 2 Pcs HVAC Delete Cabin Filters For E81 E82 E87 E88 E90 E91 E92 E93 E84
body_html:
Innenraumluftfilter für BMW E82 E88 E90 E91 E92 E93 X1 E84 335i 135i 328i 325i 


E-Serien-Besitzer wissen, dass das Entfernen der Motorhaube und des HVAC-Filtersystems nicht nur das Gewicht des Fahrzeugs reduziert, sondern auch die Kühlung des gesamten Motorraums verbessert, die Wartung des Motors und der DME-Box erleichtert und es dem Fahrer ermöglicht, den laufenden Motor besser zu hören. 

Aber es stellt sich immer die Frage, wie man verhindert, dass Staub und Schmutz in das interne Belüftungssystem gelangen. 

Aus diesem Grund haben wir eine einfache Version des Klimaanlagenfilters eingeführt, die speziell für diese Aufgabe entwickelt wurde.


Merkmale:

【Reduziertes Fahrzeuggewicht】Reduziert das Gewicht um ca. 10 lbs, ohne Haube und HVAC-Filtersystem.

【Bessere Kühlung des Motorraums】Der Motor klingt ohne Motorhaube besser und ermöglicht eine bessere Kühlung.

【Klimaanlagenfilter】Hält Schmutz und Ablagerungen aus dem inneren Belüftungssystem fern.

【Einfache Kontrolle und Wartung】Einfacher Zugang zu DME-Boxen oder Wartung von Zündkerzen, Ventildeckeln, etc.

【Einfache Installation und Reinigung】Zur Reinigung mit Wasser abspülen, trocknen lassen und wieder einbauen. Nicht einölen.


Spezifikationen:

Zustand: Brandneu

Typ: Kutten-Filter

Farbe: Schwarz

Artikel enthalten: 2pcs Kuttenfilter


Hinweis: Schrauben sind nicht im Lieferumfang enthalten, Sie können 07147146539 oder ähnlich große Schrauben verwenden.

  • [Premium Cover & Cloud-Soft Seating Comfort] The breathable fabric with a fine texture invites you to linger. Underneath is a highly elastic upholstery that offers optimal support and retains its shape even after years - for an incomparable sitting as if on clouds.

  • [Modular flexibility – your sofa, your room planning] Thanks to the well thought-out modular system, the chaise longue can be mounted either on the left or right. This smart adaptability allows you to adapt the sofa perfectly to any floor plan situation, for a tailor-made solution that makes the most of your living space.

Product Features

  • Available in different sizes, 25 cm thick. The mattresses are available in the sizes 90 x 200, 120 x 200, 140 x 200, 160 x 200 and 180 x 200 cm, all with a thickness of 25 cm – the optimal height according to ergonomics and sleep medicine. They provide differentiated support for different areas such as the shoulders, waist and hips, helping the spine to maintain its natural physiological curvature in the lateral and supine position.
  • 7 individually wrapped feathers ensure undisturbed sleep. Each spring is individually wrapped to provide precise 7-zone support: the head, shoulders, waist, hips, thighs, calves and feet respond to pressure in different zones. Thicker, denser and more durable springs than conventional springs are less susceptible to deformation and retain their elasticity for a long time. Movements and vibrations are effectively isolated, making the mattress ideal for restless sleepers.
  • There is a wave-shaped, breathable sponge layer over the feathers: the textured surface improves microcirculation, wicks away moisture and heat, preventing heat build-up in summer and moisture in winter. The gentle massage effect promotes microcirculation in the subcutaneous tissue and relieves muscle tension. As a transitional layer, it softens the firm support of the springs and thus provides more lying comfort without impairing the support effect.
  • The filling, which comes into direct contact with the body, is made of glue-free cotton: since no chemical adhesives are used, the mattress is formaldehyde-free and odorless. Soft and fluffy, it increases comfort and improves breathability. Particularly suitable for seniors, children and people with sensitive skin, it allows carefree sleeping without clothes.
  • The mattress is equipped with two high-strength handles on each side (four in total): this allows the mattress to rotate regularly and prevents punctual pressure points that can lead to coolness. Changing the bed linen, changing or adjusting the direction of the bed can be easily done by one person. The handles are robust, neatly sewn, tear-resistant and extremely resilient.
